camel_example: aliyun eventbridge GetDocumentDownloadUrl --region cn-hangzhou --NetworkType PUBLIC --DocumentId 'doc-bp1xxxxxxxxxxxx' --KnowledgeBaseName 'my-knowledge-base' --Catalog my_catalog --Namespace my_namespace
description_en: Retrieves the download URL of a document
name: GetDocumentDownloadUrl

parameters.help_en: The data catalog to which the knowledge base belongs. This parameter, together with Namespace and KnowledgeBaseName, uniquely identifies a knowledge base. You can call ListCatalogs to obtain the value
parameters.help_zh: 知识库所属的数据目录，与 Namespace、KnowledgeBaseName 共同定位知识库。可通过 ListCatalogs 获取
parameters.name: catalog

parameters.help_en: The namespace to which the knowledge base belongs. The namespace must belong to the specified data catalog. This parameter, together with Catalog and KnowledgeBaseName, uniquely identifies a knowledge base. You can call ListNamespaces to obtain the value
parameters.help_zh: 知识库所属的命名空间，必须属于指定的数据目录，与 Catalog、KnowledgeBaseName 共同定位知识库。可通过 ListNamespaces 获取
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: The name of the knowledge base. The name is unique within the namespace and is determined at creation time. It cannot be modified
parameters.help_zh: 知识库名称，命名空间内唯一；创建时确定，不可修改
parameters.name: knowledge_base_name

parameters.help_en:
The network type of the pre-signed URL. Valid values:

PUBLIC (default): accessible over the Internet.
INTERNAL: accessible only within the same region on the Alibaba Cloud internal network, with no Internet data transfer fees
parameters.help_zh: 预签名 URL 的网络类型。PUBLIC（默认）：公网可达；INTERNAL：仅阿里云同地域内网可达，免公网流量费
parameters.name: network_type

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of Success indicates a successful call. If the call fails, a specific error code is returned
Code.description_zh: 接口返回码，Success 表示成功，失败时为具体错误码
Code.title_en: 接口返回码，Success 表示成功
Code.title_zh: 接口返回码，Success 表示成功

Data.description_zh: 文档下载 URL 信息

DownloadUrl.description_en: A short-lived GET pre-signed URL that the client uses to download the original file
DownloadUrl.description_zh: 短时有效的 GET 预签名 URL，客户端使用该地址下载原始文件

ExpireAt.description_en: The expiration time of the pre-signed download URL, in ISO 8601 UTC format
ExpireAt.description_zh: 预签名下载地址的过期时间，ISO8601 UTC 格式

Message.description_en: The message returned by the operation. A value of Operation success indicates a successful call. If the call fails, a specific error description is returned
Message.description_zh: 接口返回的提示信息，成功时为 Operation success，失败时为具体错误描述

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful. A value of true indicates success
Success.description_zh: 本次调用是否成功，true 表示成功
